name: task-manager-uat
description: Operator-only Task Manager UAT profile for on-demand local file-first validation.

interface.shortDescription: Validate Task Manager safely against UAT.
interface.longDescription: Operator-only validation profile. The macOS companion exposes upload_local_file and attach_local_file_to_task, performs no discovery-time network or credential access, and uses a manually started loopback-only private-UAT ingress when file validation is needed. It has no hosted MCP dependency and never uses Keychain. Use synthetic data only.
defaultPrompt: Upload an exact local file into Task Manager UAT
Bind a verified local fileRef to a UAT Task
Run the local UAT file-first upload and bind smoke
